page.title: 数量は、強さのメーター

analysis.summaryJa: 数量表現は単に数を示すだけでなく、話し手が『ほぼゼロ』『少し』『かなり多い』『多すぎる』のどこに置くかという強度も伝える。hardly any / almost noからa couple of、a few/a little、quite a few、a lot of、too many/too muchまでの段階を、可算・不可算の区別とともに捉える。またa number of + 複数名詞は『多数の』で複数一致するのに対し、the number of + 複数名詞は『その数』が主語なので単数一致する。
grammarPoints: hardly any / almost noは可算・不可算の数量をほぼ0として表す
a couple of + 複数可算名詞は会話で2、3ほどの小数量を表せる
quite a few + 複数可算名詞は『かなり多くの』という強い数量を表す
a lot ofは可算複数・不可算の両方で自然な『多い』を表す
too many + 複数可算名詞 / too much + 不可算名詞は許容量を超える
a number of + 複数名詞は複数一致、the number of + 複数名詞は単数一致する
visualEvidence: 数量メーターがほぼ0から過剰域まで段階を示す
可算レールと不可算レールが柔軟な数量表現へ合流する
hardly anyからtoo many/too muchまでの強度のはしご
a number ofとthe number ofを別の主語構造として比べるボックス
赤い過剰ゾーンでtoo many / too muchを示す
commonTraps: quite a fewをfewと同じ『ほとんどない』と誤解する
不可算名詞にtoo many、複数可算名詞にtoo muchを使う
a number of + 複数名詞を単数一致させる
the number of + 複数名詞を直後の複数名詞につられて複数一致させる
a couple ofの後ろを単数名詞にする
hardly anyに二重否定を重ねる

questions.prompt: There are ------- parking spaces available near the west entrance, so early arrival is recommended.
questions.translationJa: 西側入口の近くには利用できる駐車スペースがほとんどないため、早めの到着をお勧めします。
questions.explanationJa: parking spacesは複数可算名詞で、早めの到着が必要なほど『ほぼゼロ』なのでhardly anyが適切です。

questions.prompt: The technician said the restart would take ------- minutes.
questions.translationJa: 技術者は再起動には2、3分ほどかかると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: a couple of + 複数可算名詞で、厳密な2ではなく会話的に『2、3ほど』という少量を表せます。
questions.focus: a couple of + 複数可算名詞

questions.prompt: ------- employees volunteered to test the new scheduling tool, giving us enough feedback for the pilot.
questions.translationJa: かなり多くの従業員が新しい日程調整ツールの試験に志願し、試験運用に十分な意見が集まりました。
questions.explanationJa: Quite a fewは形だけ見るとfewを含みますが、実際には『かなり多くの』という強い数量を表します。
questions.focus: quite a few = かなり多い

questions.prompt: The reception desk received ------- calls during the outage and had to add two temporary operators.
questions.translationJa: 障害中に受付には電話が多すぎて、臨時担当者を2人追加する必要がありました。
questions.explanationJa: callsは複数可算で、対応能力を超える『多すぎる数』なのでtoo manyを使います。

questions.prompt: The revised handbook contains ------- useful examples for new employees.
questions.translationJa: 改訂版の手引きには新入社員向けの役立つ例がたくさん載っています。
questions.explanationJa: examplesは複数可算名詞で、肯定文の『多くの』にはa lot ofが自然です。
questions.focus: a lot of + 可算複数

questions.prompt: A number of customer requests ------- still waiting for approval.
questions.translationJa: 多数の顧客依頼がまだ承認待ちです。
questions.explanationJa: A number of + 複数名詞では意味上の中心がrequestsなので、複数動詞areを使います。
questions.focus: a number of + 複数動詞

questions.prompt: The number of delayed shipments ------- fallen since the warehouse added a night shift.
questions.translationJa: 倉庫が夜勤を追加して以来、遅延出荷の件数は減っています。
questions.explanationJa: The number of + 複数名詞では主語の中心は単数のnumberなのでhas fallenと単数一致します。
questions.focus: the number of + 単数動詞

questions.prompt: There is ------- demand for the discontinued model, so the remaining stock will be transferred.
questions.translationJa: 廃番モデルへの需要はほとんどないため、残りの在庫は移送されます。
questions.explanationJa: demandは不可算名詞で、数量メーターのほぼ0を表すalmost noが自然です。

questions.prompt: The cafeteria added more tables because there were ------- people waiting for seats at noon.
questions.translationJa: 昼には席を待つ人が多すぎたため、食堂はテーブルを増やしました。
questions.explanationJa: peopleは複数可算で、設備追加が必要になる過剰な人数をtoo manyで表します。

questions.prompt: The project used ------- paper during the first review cycle, so all drafts are now shared digitally.
questions.translationJa: 最初のレビュー期間に紙を使いすぎたため、現在はすべての草稿をデジタルで共有しています。
questions.explanationJa: paperは物質として不可算名詞なので、過剰な量にはtoo muchを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence meaning that there are almost no vacancies.

choices.A: There is hardly any vacancies this month.
choices.B: There are hardly vacancy this month.
choices.C: There are hardly any vacancies this month.
choices.D: There are a hardly few vacancies this month.

questions.translationJa: 今月は空きがほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: vacanciesは複数可算名詞で、『ほぼ0』はhardly any vacanciesと表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a short wait of roughly two or three days.

choices.A: Please allow a couple days of for processing.
choices.B: Please allow a couple of day for processing.
choices.C: Please allow much couple of days for processing.
choices.D: Please allow a couple of days for processing.

questions.translationJa: 処理には2、3日ほど見込んでください。
questions.explanationJa: a couple ofの後ろには複数可算名詞daysを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence meaning that a surprisingly large number of guests arrived early.

choices.A: Quite a few guests arrived early.
choices.C: Quite a little guests arrived early.

questions.translationJa: かなり多くの来客が早めに到着しました。
questions.explanationJa: Quite a few + 複数可算名詞で『かなり多くの』を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about excessive luggage.

choices.A: We brought too many luggage for the small rental car.
choices.B: We brought too much luggage for the small rental car.
choices.C: We brought too much luggages for the small rental car.
choices.D: We brought too many luggages for the small rental car.

questions.translationJa: 小さなレンタカーには荷物を持ってきすぎました。
questions.explanationJa: luggageは不可算名詞なので『多すぎる量』はtoo much luggageです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about numerous active subscriptions.

choices.A: A number of subscriptions is due for renewal this week.
choices.B: The number of subscriptions are due for renewal this week when referring to the count.
choices.C: A number of subscriptions are due for renewal this week.
choices.D: A number of subscription are due for renewal this week.

questions.translationJa: 多数の契約が今週更新時期を迎えます。
questions.explanationJa: a number of + 複数名詞は複数主語として扱い、areを使います。
questions.focus: a number of + 複数一致

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence referring to the count itself.

choices.A: The number of complaints are decreasing.
choices.B: A number of complaints is decreasing when the count itself is meant.
choices.C: The number of complaint are decreasing.
choices.D: The number of complaints is decreasing.

questions.translationJa: 苦情の件数は減少しています。
questions.explanationJa: the number of complaintsの主語の中心はnumberなので単数動詞isを使います。
questions.focus: the number of + 単数一致

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a large quantity of office space.

choices.A: The company leases a lot of office space downtown.
choices.B: The company leases many office space downtown.
choices.C: The company leases a lot office spaces downtown.
choices.D: The company leases too many office space downtown.

questions.translationJa: その会社は中心街に多くのオフィススペースを借りています。
questions.explanationJa: spaceは不可算的に扱え、a lot ofは不可算名詞にも使えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence meaning that almost no information was provided.

choices.A: The notice provided almost few information about parking.
choices.B: The notice provided almost no information about parking.
choices.C: The notice provided hardly informations about parking.
choices.D: The notice provided a couple of information about parking.

questions.translationJa: その案内には駐車場についてほとんど情報がありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: informationは不可算名詞で、almost no informationで『ほぼ0』を表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an excessive number of attachments.

choices.A: The email has too much attachments to send through the old server.
choices.B: The email has too many attachment to send through the old server.
choices.C: The email has too many attachments to send through the old server.
choices.D: The email has much too attachments to send through the old server.

questions.translationJa: そのメールは添付ファイルが多すぎて旧サーバーでは送れません。
questions.explanationJa: attachmentsは複数可算名詞なのでtoo manyを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence distinguishing a quantity phrase from a count phrase.

choices.A: A number of stores is participating, and the number of participants are rising.
choices.B: The number of stores are participating, and a number of participants is rising.
choices.C: A number of store are participating, and the number of participants are rising.
choices.D: A number of stores are participating, and the number of participants is rising.

questions.translationJa: 多数の店舗が参加しており、参加者数も増えています。
questions.explanationJa: a number of storesは複数一致、the number of participantsはnumberが中心なので単数一致します。
questions.focus: a number of / the number of

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Almost no seats remain.”

choices.A: There are a lot of seats left.
choices.B: There are hardly any seats left.
choices.C: There are quite a few seats left.
choices.D: There are too many seats left.

questions.translationJa: 残席はほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: almost noとhardly anyはどちらも数量がほぼゼロであることを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The repair should take only two or three hours.”

choices.A: The repair should take a couple of hours.
choices.B: The repair should take too much hours.
choices.C: The repair should take quite a few hours.
choices.D: The repair should take hardly any hour.

questions.translationJa: 修理には2、3時間ほどしかかからない見込みです。
questions.explanationJa: a couple ofは会話では『2、3ほど』の短い数量を表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “A surprisingly large number of customers renewed early.”

choices.D: Quite a few customers renewed early.

questions.translationJa: かなり多くの顧客が早めに更新しました。
questions.explanationJa: quite a fewは『少なくない、かなり多い』という意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The quantity of waste exceeds what is acceptable.”

choices.B: There is a couple of waste.

questions.translationJa: 廃棄物の量が多すぎます。
questions.explanationJa: wasteを不可算の量として捉え、許容範囲を超える量をtoo muchで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Many departments requested the guide.”

choices.A: The number of departments requested the guide.
choices.B: A number of departments requested the guide.
choices.C: A little departments requested the guide.
choices.D: Hardly any departments requested the guide.

questions.translationJa: 多数の部署がそのガイドを求めました。
questions.explanationJa: a number of + 複数名詞は『いくつもの、多数の』という数量表現です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The total count of active users is growing.”

choices.A: The number of active users is growing.
choices.B: A number of active users is growing.
choices.C: The number of active users are growing.
choices.D: Quite a few active users is growing.

questions.translationJa: アクティブユーザー数は増えています。
questions.explanationJa: 『その数』自体を主語にするとthe number ofとなり、numberに合わせてisを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The office receives many deliveries every morning.”

choices.A: The office receives too much deliveries every morning.
choices.B: The office receives hardly any deliveries every morning.
choices.C: The office receives the number of deliveries every morning.
choices.D: The office receives a lot of deliveries every morning.

questions.translationJa: そのオフィスには毎朝たくさんの配送物が届きます。
questions.explanationJa: a lot ofは複数可算名詞deliveriesにも使え、manyの自然な言い換えになります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The team had virtually no time to prepare.”

choices.A: The team had quite a few time to prepare.
choices.B: The team had too many time to prepare.
choices.C: The team had hardly any time to prepare.
choices.D: The team had a couple of time to prepare.

questions.translationJa: チームには準備する時間がほとんどありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: hardly anyは不可算名詞timeにも使え、『ほぼ0』を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The queue contained more people than the desk could handle.”

choices.A: There was too much people in the queue.
choices.B: There were too many people in the queue.
choices.C: There were hardly any people in the queue.
choices.D: There were a couple of people in the queue.

questions.translationJa: 列には窓口で対応できる以上の人がいました。
questions.explanationJa: peopleは複数可算で、処理能力を超える人数はtoo many peopleです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Only a negligible amount of noise was heard.”

choices.B: There were quite a few noise.
choices.D: There was a lot of noise.

questions.translationJa: 聞こえた騒音はほぼありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: noiseは不可算名詞で、negligible amountはalmost noで表せます。

questions.prompt: Hotel notice: There are ------- rooms available for tonight because a tour group extended its stay.
questions.translationJa: ホテル案内：団体客が滞在を延長したため、今夜利用できる部屋はほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: roomsは可算複数で、空きがほぼゼロの文脈なのでhardly anyが適切です。

questions.prompt: Support chat: Please wait ------- minutes while I verify the serial number.
questions.translationJa: サポートチャット：シリアル番号を確認しますので、2、3分お待ちください。
questions.explanationJa: 短い待ち時間を会話的に示すにはa couple of + minutesが自然です。

questions.prompt: Event recap: ------- employees stayed after the presentation to speak with the guest lecturer.
questions.translationJa: イベント報告：かなり多くの従業員が発表後も残り、招待講師と話しました。
questions.explanationJa: Quite a fewは複数可算名詞に付き『かなり多くの』を表します。

questions.prompt: Expense reminder: The team spent ------- money on last-minute shipping, so next month's budget will be tighter.
questions.translationJa: 経費注意：チームは直前発送にお金を使いすぎたため、来月の予算は厳しくなります。
questions.explanationJa: moneyは不可算名詞で、予算を圧迫する過剰量にはtoo muchを使います。

questions.prompt: Operations report: ------- of the branch offices are now using the new reservation platform.
questions.translationJa: 業務報告：多数の支店が現在、新しい予約プラットフォームを利用しています。
questions.explanationJa: A number of + 複数名詞は『多数の〜』で、後続のareとも複数一致します。

questions.prompt: Monthly dashboard: The number of unresolved tickets ------- lower than it was in July.
questions.translationJa: 月次ダッシュボード：未解決チケットの件数は7月より少なくなっています。
questions.explanationJa: 主語の中心が単数のnumberなのでisを使います。
questions.focus: the number of + 単数一致

questions.prompt: Cafeteria memo: We ordered ------- sandwiches for the afternoon workshop, enough for all registered participants.
questions.translationJa: 食堂メモ：午後の研修用にサンドイッチをたくさん注文し、登録者全員分を確保しました。
questions.explanationJa: sandwichesは複数可算で、十分な多数を表すa lot ofが自然です。

questions.prompt: Security alert: There were ------- visitors in the building after 10 p.m.; the lobby was essentially empty.
questions.translationJa: 警備通知：午後10時以降、建物内には来訪者がほとんどおらず、ロビーは実質的に空でした。
questions.explanationJa: visitorsは複数可算で、essentially emptyがalmost noを支持します。

questions.prompt: IT memo: The shared drive contains ------- duplicate files, and cleanup is slowing the migration.
questions.translationJa: ITメモ：共有ドライブには重複ファイルが多すぎて、整理作業が移行を遅らせています。
questions.explanationJa: filesは複数可算で、悪影響を生む過剰数をtoo manyで表します。

questions.prompt: Travel update: We have ------- flexibility in the departure time because the charter bus is fixed at 6:30 a.m.
questions.translationJa: 出張更新：貸切バスが午前6時30分に固定されているため、出発時間にはほとんど融通が利きません。
questions.explanationJa: flexibilityは不可算名詞で、ほぼゼロの量にはhardly anyが使えます。
